mapper.select: select id,name,room_type_id roomTypeId,area_id areaId ,area_sequence areaSequence,status status,floorage floorage ,floorage_billing floorageBilling from room where tenant = #{tenant}

select id,name,status,deleted from room where deleted !=0 and tenant = #{tenant} and id in
#{item}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(floorage_billing),0) FROM room
and status = #{status}

select.foreach: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(if(`status`='NORMAL',floorage_billing,0)),0) useArea ,COALESCE(SUM(if(`status`='STOPPING',floorage_billing,0)),0) disabledArea ,COALESCE(SUM(floorage_billing),0) total ,${item} as areaId FROM room where area_sequence like concat('%',${item},'%')

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(b.id),0) num ,c.`name` industry FROM room_rent_record a LEFT JOIN enterprise b ON a.enterprise_id = b.id LEFT JOIN type_data c ON b.industry_type_id = c.id WHERE a.end_time > NOW() GROUP BY c.`name`
SELECT COALESCE( SUM( c.floorage_billing ), 0 ) FROM room_rent_record a LEFT JOIN room_rent_record_room b ON a.id = b.record_id LEFT JOIN room c ON b.room_id = c.id WHERE a.end_time > NOW( )
SELECT COALESCE( COUNT( enterprise_id ), 0 ) num, DATE_FORMAT( sign_time, '%m' ) timeFlag FROM room_rent_record where sign_time between #{st} and #{et} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( sign_time, '%m' )

SELECT COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( NOW() <= a.end_time and c.STATUS = 'NORMAL', c.floorage_billing, 0 ) ), 0 ) AS rentedArea, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( c.STATUS = 'NORMAL', c.floorage_billing, 0 ) ), 0 ) total , c.area_id areaId FROM room c LEFT JOIN room_rent_record_room b ON c.id = b.room_id LEFT JOIN room_rent_record a ON a.id = b.record_id where c.area_sequence like concat("%",#{areaId},"%") GROUP BY c.area_id
